title: Chapter 277 Winning Streak
content:
Chapter 277 Winning Streak

Seeing that Xu Zijing was frightened by him, Ao Qing felt a little relieved.

I just accidentally let it go.

If this is because I have caused some accidents to the little master, it will not be enough for me to apologize for death.

Obviously, Ao Qing still knew the seriousness of this matter.

Xu Zijing, who was in front of Ao Qing, didn't dare to say anything else when he saw Ao Qing like this, and hurriedly retreated not far away.

You can't afford to offend.

At this time, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo walked to Xu Zijing with awkward smile.

"Brother Xu, don't care, the dragon clan has always had such a personality."

"Yes, yes, Brother Qin is right. The dragon clan's personality has always been like this, let alone the nine-clawed dragon."

Hearing this, Xu Zijing also smiled.

"It's okay, I don't care."

He said this, but Xu Zijing was still full of interest in the destiny man that Ao Qing just mentioned.

A man of destiny.

Is it what I think?

Just as Xu Zijing was in deep thought, a shout suddenly sounded from the square.

"Damn it, the martial arts list is thirty!"

Everyone looked up and saw that the 30th place in the martial arts list suddenly turned into Lu Xue.

Suddenly, the sound of gasping in the air kept echoing from the square.

On the first day, I reached the 30th place in the martial arts list, and I started from 100th place. What does this mean?

At this moment, as time goes by, more and more people come to the square to pay attention.

There are students from the Martial Arts Academy and students from the Literature Academy.

Similarly, some teachers also came here.

At the same time, Jordanyang and Tan Songci also came to pay attention.

Everyone's faces were full of disbelief at the appearance of the two mentors.

They have never seen any tutor who comes to pay attention to students’ rankings.

Unless it is your own student.

But Lu Xue’s mentor is Xiao Yin, and the entire academy knows about this.

Now, Teacher Xiao is still fighting against the Immortal Emperor List, and there is no result yet. Instead, Teacher Qiao and Teacher Tan are here.

Everyone looked puzzled.

The two of them ignored everyone's gaze and came straight towards Qin Feng and others.

"Student, I have met two mentors."

Qin Feng and others saluted Jordanyang and the others respectfully.

The two nodded slightly, then looked up at the martial arts list.

"This girl is indeed extraordinary."

Jordan Yang sighed.

Tan Songci, on the side, also said, "According to this momentum, he should be able to enter the top ten."

Hearing the comments of the two mentors, Qin Feng and the other men showed a look of surprise on their faces, but their hearts were very calm.

As for Ao Qing, he was too lazy to take a look at these two inner courtyard tutors, and his pupils were always staring at Wuta, staring at him without blinking his eyes.

It seems that you can really see Lu Xue fighting through Wuta.

"Brother Qing, how is Sister Xue now?"

Seeing Ao Qing so serious, Qin Feng stepped forward and joked.

Hearing this, Ao Qing said lightly: "Easy."

"Easy?"

"Brother Qing, can you see it?"

Qin Feng was a little stunned, and Jordanyang and the others looked at Ao Qing on the side.

There are restrictions outside the Wu Tower, and even people with their strength cannot see the scene inside through the Wu Tower.

No matter how terrifying the talent of this dragon is, it doesn’t even have the Immortal Emperor realm. Can you see it?

In response, Ao Qing shook his head slightly, "I can't see it, but I can feel it."

But even so, the few people were still full of shock.

"By the way, Qin Feng."

At this time, Jordanyang suddenly looked at Qin Feng.

"Teacher Qiao."

Qin Feng looked puzzled, wondering why Jordanyang suddenly called him.

Jordan Yang coughed lightly and whispered: "I heard from your master that senior killer apprentice, have you followed you back to the academy?"

Upon hearing this, Qin Feng understood.

So that's what happened.

"Yes, she lives in Zhuyunfeng now. Teacher Qiao wants to find her?"

Hearing this, Jordan Yang was excited, but still said calmly: "Well, there is indeed something."

"Then you guys are busy, I'll go to Zhuyun Peak to take a look."

After saying this, Jordanyang left here directly.

Qin Feng and Xiao Luo were speechless when they were still in place, looking at Jordanyang who had decisively left.

It turns out that this is the purpose of Mentor Qiao.

Sister Xue said that for the past ten years, Yuanyuan has been chasing Yunfeng, refining elixirs day and night.

Basically, I don't even go out of the door.

Lu Xue didn't care much about this.

Anyway, when something happens, I will definitely call her.

I don’t know what will happen to Mentor Qiao this time.

And at this time, inside the martial tower.

boom!

There was a loud bang.

As the figure of the man in front of him broke, a teleportation array appeared in front of Lu Xue.

At this moment, Lu Xue was already familiar with the road and stepped directly into the teleportation array.

The space trembled slightly.

Lu Xue's figure suddenly appeared on the next floor.

【28th place in the martial arts list】

【Monsanhan】

[Realm, first level of the Immortal Saint Realm]

Looking at the sudden news in front of him, Lu Xue sighed softly.

"Finally, he is the opponent of the Immortal Saint Realm."

Her current realm is at the peak of the Immortal Lord Realm, and she has entered the Immortal Saint Realm with half her feet. As long as she wants, she can be promoted to the Immortal Saint Realm at any time.

But she didn't do that.

It’s just because her cultivation speed is too fast and her haste is not achieved. She needs to settle in the Immortal Lord Realm for a period of time.

In this way, use the best state to break through the Immortal Saint Realm.

However, Lu Xue used the best martial arts and practiced the best martial arts. Her strength was among the same level. It cannot be said that she was the strongest, but she was definitely a terrifying existence.

In addition, Lu Dao took care of Lu Xue in his life, his physical condition was basically free of impurities.

The power is extremely pure.

All the control of martial arts and martial arts is easy to grasp.

From the time of breaking into the martial arts tower to now, Lu Xue has basically never felt the pressure.

Looking at the phantom slowly appeared in front of him, Lu Xue's expression became rare and serious.

This is the first time she has faced an opponent who is one level higher than her.

Buzz —

With a buzzing sound.

The battle begins.

A shocking cold air emanated from the distant shadows, and countless black ice blades suddenly appeared in the surrounding space.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue was stunned.

The next moment.

The Xuanbing Blade hit Lu Xue.

However, Lu Xue was indifferent and allowed the sharp blade to penetrate her body.

laugh!

"really."

On the spot, Lu Xue looked at the sharp blade inserted on her body, but there was a faint smile on her face.

Playing with ice in front of yourself, isn’t that going to dance a big sword in front of Guan Gong?

The black ice blade melted all the time, and then turned into pure energy and rushed straight into Lu Xue's body.

This is not only because of Lu Xue's proficient control of ice-based martial arts, but also because of her own physique.

At the beginning, what I woke up was the Extreme Ice Spirit Body and the Ice Phoenix Bloodline.

Later, as Lu Xue obtained more and more resources and became more and more terrifying, Lu Xue's physique began to evolve continuously.

Now, Lu Xue doesn’t know what her current physique is.

Anyway, it's just right.

When facing yourself, all ice-based martial arts basically lose their due power.
